messages:
Maria S.: Hey team — KPMG just sent back the SIG. They want question-by-question evidence and a couple of diagrams. Can Security help with the answers and where we should upload artifacts?

Devon P.: Thanks—can you attach the SIG PDF? I only have the redacted list.

Maria S.: Attached in the ticket but pasting key ask: they want proof for ENC-3 (encryption at rest) + KMS usage, network isolation screenshots for Dedicated vs Hosted, and SOC2 report.

Evan L.: For ENC-3 we can point to our KMS integration doc and key rotation policy. Who can produce a short exportable snippet of the KMS policy?

Priya K.: I can export the Key Rotation section from our runbook and a JSON of the CMK alias list. Will redact ARNs tied to customers.

Maria S.: KPMG asked for a secure upload link (SFTP or presigned S3). Do we have a standard share path for third-party vendors?

SecBot: Reminder: Use approved vendor repo for external uploads. Generate a presigned S3 link via the Evidence Portal. Link expires in 7 days.

Devon P.: Pref surface: we should send them a manifest + ZIP with: (1) SOC2 Type II redacted pdf, (2) KMS rotation snippet, (3) network diagram (VPCs), (4) Dedicated config template.

Evan L.: I'll draft the network diagram. Quick question: for the VPC diagram do we show internal subnets or mask internal CIDRs? KPMG prefers high-level only.

Priya K.: Mask CIDRs and remove internal hostnames. Provide an arrow showing traffic flow (customer -> load balancer -> inference pool) and note control points: NAT, security groups, egress proxy.

Maria S.: Timeline from KPMG is EOD Friday for initial upload. Can Security get first batch by Thursday morning?

Evan L.: I can do the diagram by Wed EOD. Priya — can you drop the KMS JSON by Thursday morning?

Priya K.: Yes, aiming Thu 09:00 UTC. I'll redact customer ARNs and append a checksum file.

Devon P.: Maria — I'll prepare the manifest and .zip template. Where do we host the presigned link? SecBot said Evidence Portal. How do I get access?

Maria S.: @SecBot can you generate the presigned S3 path and confirm retention policy? Also we need an audit log of downloads for KPMG procurement.

SecBot: Generating presigned URL...

SecBot: Presigned URL created: https://evidence.redwood-inference.internal/sig-upload/1768504321?t=expires

SecBot: Retention policy: 14 days. Audit: every download is logged to the evidence-audit index.

Devon P.: Perfect. Will upload manifest + zip there once Evan and Priya confirm. I'll also include a short README mapping SIG question IDs -> file names.

Evan L.: FYI — for ENC-3 I'll add the KMS key usage diagram and a sample API call showing encryption header; something like:

```
POST /v1/encrypt
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
Content-Type: application/json
{"key_id":"alias/redwood-prod-kms","plaintext":"<base64>"}
```

Priya K.: That API example is fine as long as we redact real key IDs. Use alias placeholders.

Maria S.: One blocker from procurement: they asked whether Dedicated instances are eligible for an offline audit in our Private offering. We need a short statement from Legal/Security confirming yes/no.

Evan L.: I can draft a technical statement: "Dedicated/Private deployments support on-prem/air-gapped audits depending on contract and deployment architecture; coordinate with Customer Ops for scheduling." Legal review required.

Priya K.: I'll ping Legal for sign-off and add an explicit note in the manifest that any audit scheduling requires 30 days lead time.

Maria S.: Great. After upload I'll notify KPMG with the presigned link and manifest. Thanks all — please post when items are uploaded. :thumbsup:

Devon P.: Uploaded manifest + placeholder zip to the presigned link. File names: 1768504321-manifest.json, 1768504321-sig-bundle.zip (contains placeholder files).

Evan L.: Uploaded network-diagram-v1.svg and encryption-snippet.txt to the same link.

Priya K.: Uploaded kms-rotation-redacted.json and checksum.sha256.

Maria S.: I've sent the email to KPMG with link and manifest. They acknowledged receipt and asked for a short walkthrough call Friday 16:00 UTC. I'll schedule and invite Security.

SecBot: Ticket #SIG-3478 updated: artifacts uploaded, presigned link used 3 times.

Maria S.: Closing loop here, thanks everyone. If Legal approves the audit note I'll add that to the bundle.

Evan L.: Quick follow-up: should we version the files for later audits? I recommend v1 in filenames.

Devon P.: Good call — we'll append _v1 to final uploads.

Maria S.: End of thread.
